goal: Deliver a company goal through a small dependency graph with explicit acceptance and escalation.
acceptance: Every dependent task names the prerequisite artifact or control gate.
A failed prerequisite blocks dependent dispatch; shared people retain their identity.
The return contains the deliverable and unresolved issue, not every intermediate conversation.
prompt: Plan at most three useful work units for this goal. Name dependencies, owners, per-unit caps and acceptance checks. Reuse the listed shared service employees. Stop if the packet lacks required evidence.
